# `silk/platform/native/process`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Runs a child process with the system calls, for the native `ChildProcess` provider.

## When to use
`silk.system.child_process_native` uses `NativeProcess.execute`. Application code uses the `ChildProcess`
effect from `silk.system.child_process` instead.

## Details
Each call owns its descriptors, its copies of the request, and its child. If a step fails after
the child started, the call stops and waits for the child, closes the descriptors, and then
returns the first error.

## Gotchas
- The calls block the thread.
- A trap does not clean up, and does not stop the child.
